title: CPython 3.14 test loader does not register the local runtime-smoke module before dataclass processing
title_de: CPython-3.14-Testloader registriert das lokale Runtime-Smoke-Modul vor der Dataclass-Verarbeitung nicht
profile: Parent PR #74 normal master update under CPython 3.14.4
observed_behavior: On the PR #74 worktree after the normal uncommitted merge of current Parent master, CPython 3.14.4 fails during import of tests/test_local_runtime_smoke_request_body.py. The test creates SMOKE with importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC) and executes it without sys.modules[SPEC.name] registration. The imported smoke runner now declares RuntimeOutputPaths with @dataclass, and CPython 3.14.4 dataclasses._is_type dereferences the missing module entry, raising AttributeError before any request-body or runtime-path test runs.
expected_behavior: The test must register its dynamically loaded module under SPEC.name before exec_module. The focused request-body, parser-rejection, and runtime-output-path tests must run under the selected CPython 3.14.4 interpreter without changing the smoke runner's request framing, error status, or output-path confinement behavior.
impact: PR #74 cannot complete its focused security and regression test suite under the repository's CPython 3.14 lane. This is a test-loader compatibility defect, not evidence of a production request parser or path-confinement bypass.
preconditions: Use the selected Parent virtual-environment interpreter, CPython 3.14.4.
The smoke runner declares the RuntimeOutputPaths dataclass introduced by current master.
reproduction: Run the retained focused unittest command in the evidence receipt from the PR #74 isolated worktree.
Observe AttributeError in Python 3.14 dataclasses._is_type while test-local SMOKE is absent from sys.modules.
As a legitimate import control, register module under spec.name before exec_module and observe successful RuntimeOutputPaths import.

evidence.command: Focused CPython 3.14.4 unittest invocation followed by a direct registered-import control
evidence.summary: The unregistered import fails during dataclass processing; registering the module before exec_module succeeds.

evidence.command: Original request-body module and focused PR #74 regression suite under CPython 3.14.4
evidence.summary: The original module passes 10 tests and the focused suite passes 143 tests without weakening parser or path-confinement coverage.

root_cause: The test's importlib loading sequence omits the standard sys.modules[spec.name] registration. This was latent until the imported module used @dataclass; CPython 3.14.4 evaluates the class annotation context through the module registry and exposes the missing registration.
proposed_remediation: Add import sys and sys.modules[SPEC.name] = SMOKE immediately before SPEC.loader.exec_module(SMOKE) in tests/test_local_runtime_smoke_request_body.py. Do not remove the dataclass or weaken any smoke-harness request-body or runtime-output-path security control.
acceptance_criteria: The test registers SMOKE under the exact SPEC.name before exec_module.
Focused runtime-path, report-evidence, HAProxy, CI-security, bilingual-documentation, compiler-guide, and Makefile tests pass on the same exact candidate head.
The request-body framing and verified output-path security behavior remains covered and unchanged.
Fresh exact-head GitHub PR evidence is evaluated after the update; no master merge is implied.
validation_plan: Run the original failing test module on CPython 3.14.4 after the one-line registration repair.
Run the focused PR #74 regression suite covering request-body, runtime-path, report-evidence, HAProxy, CI workflow, documentation, compiler guide, and Makefile contracts.
Run the external-root HTTP authorization-service timeout smoke and git diff --check.
After publication, inspect current exact-head GitHub checks, SonarQube Cloud, review comments, and threads.
legitimate_control_tests: A direct import that registers the module under SPEC.name reaches RuntimeOutputPaths successfully on CPython 3.14.4.
The request-body test retains valid-body acceptance and invalid framing/size rejection controls.
The runtime-path test retains rejection of out-of-root and symlinked output paths.
residual_risk: Until the registration repair and focused exact-head validation are complete, CPython 3.14.4 cannot execute the affected request-body test module. This records a test compatibility gap only; no request-parser, authorization, file-path, Framework, MRTS, or Gitlink security control is waived and no risk is accepted.
